# amiga-news.de — Linux PowerPC availability report

- Original source: [Linux: PowerPC port of Robin Hood](https://www.amiga-news.de/en/news/AN-2006-07-00103-EN.html)
- Author / publication: snx; translation cad; amiga-news.de, citing Pegasos.org.
- Language / date: English translation; 2006-07-30.
- Access: Full news item retrieved directly
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Archived copy: lookup failed (archive.org rate limit); not checked
- Format: header notes, original summary, then complete factual notes (commercial news item, not transcribed)

The report credits Gunnar von Boehn’s assistance with making the game available on Linux PowerPC. It says existing Linux/x86 retail CDs can supply the installation, with a separate roughly 3 MB PowerPC update needed to run it. A demo is linked, and publication of the update on RuneSoft’s site is expected shortly.

This is a concrete historical lead for the relationship between the x86 disc and PowerPC executable. Linked downloads were not inspected, so the report does not independently establish their contents or continued availability.

## Detailed notes

Page facts: title "Linux: PowerPC port of Robin Hood"; news item dated 30 Jul 2006, timestamped 12:25; credited to snx, translation by cad (both linked to the site masthead); source line "Pegasos.org (Web page)" linking to a pegasos.org news article (sid=1131); comments count shown as 0; retrieved directly from amiga-news.de (English version of the site). The item is a three-sentence news report; the site footer claims "all rights reserved", so it is not transcribed.

- The item's title is itself a link to a page on greyhound-data.com under Gunnar von Boehn's directory (`/gunnar/robinhood/`), which the text calls "the title link".
- The game is identified as "Robin Hood - The Legend of Sherwood", a strategy game "distributed by Rune Soft for Mac OS X and Linux/x86". The game name links to a Rune Soft project page (rune-soft.com, English section, project pages, robin).
- Claim: the game "is now also available for Linux-operated PowerPC computers thanks to the assistance of Gunnar von Boehn".
- Claim: a demo version can be downloaded under the title link.
- Claim: the currently distributed CDs of the Linux/x86 full version can be installed under Linux/PPC as well.
- Claim: a "3 MB-large PowerPC update" is required for operation, and it "will also be available on the Rune Soft web page within the next few days".
- Navigation shows neighbouring items AN-2006-07-00102-EN and AN-2006-07-00104-EN; print and ASCII versions of the item are offered by the site.
- No file names, version numbers, checksums, or download sizes other than the "3 MB" figure are given. Neither the greyhound-data.com page nor the Rune Soft page was retrieved in this pass.
